caption: The video showcases a condensation-dotted chocolate-coated ice cream bar tilted upright on a white tray, its lower end held by a copper-colored binder clip. The coating is broken near the lower right edge, revealing a pale interior, and a small pool of cream-colored melted liquid already sits on the tray beneath the clip. Throughout the excerpt, the bar itself remains stationary, with no visible translation or rotation, while the bright dotted background, white tray edges, and fixed camera framing stay unchanged. The melted puddle slowly spreads outward, steadily growing slightly larger to the left and right of the clip as liquid continues to collect at the base. A thin pale drip near the broken coating appears to lengthen marginally, showing that the melting process is already underway. The owl logo watermark remains in the lower right corner, and the bar stays upright as the visible melting slowly continues.
